antonini_et_al_2025_S060: An entanglement wedge contains an island when it has a compact component disconnected from the remainder; the full wedge may also reach an asymptotic region.
geng_et_al_2026_S063: A relevant island is a compact entanglement wedge that does not reach the asymptotic part of the gravitational region; S060 examples include an asymptotic portion and therefore are not such islands.
shared_ground: Entanglement-wedge reconstruction must be defined relative to a microscopic algebra and gravitational dressing.
actual_disagreement: The papers use materially different island definitions and disagree about which compactness property matters for the information paradox.
latest_qualification: S064 produces a non-horizon local wedge saddle with added defect entropy but no full global algebra analysis.
icp_implication: Do not count the word island as a common mechanism until the algebra and geometry are aligned.

antonini_et_al_2025_S060: A proper algebra of radiation up to retarded time excludes the larger algebra containing the ADM Hamiltonian and is the physically relevant radiation subsystem.
geng_et_al_2026_S063: The complete asymptotic algebra includes the Hamiltonian and already contains interior information; excluding it imposes a blinder or formal restriction.
shared_ground: Different subalgebras can have different entropies for the same global state.
actual_disagreement: Whether the proper subalgebra or complete algebra answers the operational black-hole information question.
latest_qualification: S065 constructs right-moving CGHS asymptotic recovery under HoI assumptions and argues that commuting left/right algebras conflict with an island identification.
icp_implication: The ICP tuple must index A; no unqualified claim that information emerges is admissible.

antonini_et_al_2025_S060: Gauge-invariant operators can be compactly supported to all perturbative orders around generic backgrounds without isometries and can support island reconstruction.
geng_et_al_2026_S063: Approximate relational algebras cannot define the exact fine-grained commuting algebra required for compact islands in a pure standard-gravity state.
shared_ground: Exact nonperturbative localization is difficult and gravitational dressing matters.
actual_disagreement: Whether all-order perturbative relational localization suffices for the entropy/reconstruction claim and how exact commutants behave.
latest_qualification: S064 shows graviton masslessness alone is not a universal saddle obstruction when an extra healthy entropy sector is added.
icp_implication: Separate perturbative reconstruction error from exact algebraic factorization and state the allowed tolerance.

antonini_et_al_2025_S060: The entropy of a carefully defined proper radiation algebra is observable in principle with many copies and a fault-tolerant quantum computer.
geng_et_al_2026_S063: Such a curve measures redistribution between measured and unmeasured degrees or a detector blind spot rather than fundamental information recovery.
shared_ground: A Page curve requires a specified subsystem/algebra and may demand enormous resources.
actual_disagreement: Which algebra and measurement corresponds to the physically intended radiation question and whether the curve resolves or merely reframes the paradox.
latest_qualification: No astronomical Page-curve measurement exists; Harlow-Hayden complexity remains a separate limit.
icp_implication: Entropy presence and efficient recovery must be different fields in the evidence matrix.

antonini_et_al_2025_S060: Islands and Page curves in the original bath models are controlled examples; massive-graviton language need not be a universal requirement for every island.
geng_et_al_2026_S063: The bath makes the gravitational system open/nonstandard and supplies the setting in which information transfer and compact islands are consistent.
shared_ground: Bath coupling changes the theory boundary conditions and gives controlled Page-curve calculations.
actual_disagreement: Whether bath-model lessons generalize to standard gravity and which aspect of the coupling is essential.
latest_qualification: S062 gives a concrete broken-diffeomorphism/Goldstone-dressing mechanism in this class; S061 ties the observer algebra to the bath.
icp_implication: Treat attach-bath versus isolated-gravity as a physical intervention not a harmless representation change.

antonini_et_al_2025_S060: Islands reveal unitarity in broad reasonable quantum-gravity settings and can appear without an external reservoir.
geng_et_al_2026_S063: Asymptotic completeness already resolves Hawking's factorization error in standard gravity; compact islands are unnecessary or inconsistent there.
shared_ground: Hawking's naive spatial factorization cannot simply be assumed in gravity.
actual_disagreement: Whether islands or holography of information is the correct fine-grained description of standard massless evaporation.
latest_qualification: S064 and S065 add opposed model-level evidence but neither gives a nonperturbative realistic 4D evaporation channel.
icp_implication: ICP should register paired conditional claims and remain neutral until a common operational target is computed.
